scope: All Hilbert-space isometries with both controlled known W gates explicitly available, arbitrary density operators, all outputs retained, one unconditional T call. Affine spatial specialization on ell2(Z^8 x positive integers) uses injective integral G, integral b and n>=1. 972 finite controls are examples, not the general proof. Native implementation, general factoring complexity, all-place signed trace and RH positivity are outside the established scope.
